text:
Sarah thought she was being a culinary rebel by adding chili powder to her cookies, aiming for a sophisticated "sweet and spicy" kick. But then, in a moment of pure kitchen chaos, she confused the sugar bowl for the salt shaker. The result? A batch of "sweet and salty surprise" cookies that were so aggressively balanced that her friends were chugging milk like it was going out of style.

As for the tool used for writing? It’s a pen. Or a pencil. Or a stylus. Basically, whatever you use to put words on paper or screen. But honestly, after eating those cookies, I’m pretty sure my brain stopped trying to write anything coherent anyway.
